body: A full rust-unit tasks:: run timed out in applied_waits_while_a_server_holds_the_lock, with deliver_hands_the_message_to_a_server_elsewhere and a_tick_takes_the_server_lock_once_the_root_has_solace failing in the same run. Both pass when run alone, so they look order-dependent. I did not investigate.
title: Fix slow failing unit tests
